title: 第11章 付雨第12章 大山被打
content_zh:
陆安看着眼前这香艳的一幕，竟一时间无法反应，傻傻站在那里。
整个屋子里弥漫着淡淡的香气，一个完美无瑕的躯体展现在他面前。薄雾缭绕，却根本挡不住满满的春色，陆安的眼睛动也不动，就这样看着。
反倒是少女咬牙切齿，飞快一把从衣架上取下衣服，外衣瞬间盖住身体，同时手一挥，另外一件直接甩在陆安的脑袋上！
“还不出去？！”少女恶狠狠说道，声音中却难免有女儿家的着急。
此时陆安才猛地回过神来，脸一下子就红了，连蒙在头上的衣服都不敢去，转头便朝着身后狂奔，同时关上门，直到身体撞在椅子上才停下来！
“呼……呼……”陆安真的慌了，眼睛瞪得大大的，但是他总觉得很香，猛地意识到什么连忙将脑袋上的衣服取下来，却发现是女生的贴身衣物，不由得连忙放在一边！
只见他慌张坐在椅子上，脸红的像被东西烫了一样，甚至似乎在冒着蒸汽。整个人低头坐着，双手不停交错。
客厅里的陆安坐立不安，听着洗手间传来的悉索声，知道对方很可能要出来了，忍不住咽了一口口水，想象着自己要如何道歉。
砰！
门被打开，陆安身体一震，连忙回头看去，发现那少女站在洗手间门口，正看着他怒目而视。
“咕咚。”陆安再次咽了一口口水，跟着连忙站了起来，飞快鞠躬九十度，充满歉意说道，“很抱歉，我真的不是有心的！对不起对不起！”
只见站在门口的付雨的脸一阵红一阵白，对陆安的道歉根本听而不闻，咬牙切齿，恨得全身都在发抖！
刚刚，她正好在浴桶里洗完身子，走出来正准备擦拭身体，就被这个人给看光了！莫说是她，这种事放在哪个人身上会不生气？
别说这个人道歉了，就是给她跪下，她也不会放过！
鞠了一躬的陆安直起身，有些害怕看着眼前一脸怒意的少女，站在原地不知所措，着急说道，“我知道，一切都是我的错。如果你想骂我或者打我，我都愿意承受，只要你能消消气就行！”
“消气？”付雨几乎是从牙缝里说话，“你觉得打你一顿我就能消气？”
“不是不是……”陆安连忙摆手摇头，着急说道，“你想怎么消气就怎么做，我绝不反抗！”
“我永远都不再想看见你！”付雨咬牙说道，跟着只见难以察觉微弱的金光慢慢付上她的粉拳，眼睛中全是仇恨！
然而，陆安听到这句话后却是一愣，跟着脸色难看起来。但很快却又开口说道，“好，既然你不愿意看到我，我这去找男教师调换宿舍。”
言毕，陆安转头就朝着外面小跑，而这一跑，倒是让付雨一怔。

“换什么换？”付雨出声，阴沉说道，“那老师说的很清楚，不会给换！你是在敷衍我？”
“自然不是……”陆安闻言停下脚步，回过头看着女孩，脸上露出难看的笑容，说道，“如果真的不行的话，我就退学，不会再来打扰你。”
言毕，转头便朝着门外跑去，消失在夜色中。
这一次，反倒是付雨站在宿舍内，有些发怔看着那一道越跑越远的身影。不知道为什么，那根本不合身的宽大麻衣让她心中一动。
她虽然不是穷人家的孩子，但也知道进入学院成为一名天师对穷人家意味着什么，这个人看起来比一般的穷人家孩子还要落魄，难道会不懂吗？
还是说，这是故意演给自己看的戏？
“退学了也好，做错事总要付出代价。也还好他跑得快，否则我一定会动手杀人！”付雨心中愤恨想道。
夜色中，陆安正在学院里快步跑着。此时的学院中路上行人稀少，没有人会在意他。
content_en:
Lu An looked at the beautiful scene in front of him and was unable to react for a moment, standing there stupidly.
The whole room was filled with a faint fragrance, and a flawless body was displayed in front of him. The mist was lingering, but it couldn't block the full spring scenery at all. Lu An's eyes didn't move, just watching.
On the contrary, the girl gritted her teeth and quickly took off the clothes from the hanger. The coat instantly covered her body. At the same time, she waved her hand and threw another one directly on Lu An's head!
"Still not going out?!" the girl said fiercely, but her daughter's anxiety was unavoidable in her voice.
At this moment, Lu An suddenly came back to his senses. His face turned red all of a sudden. He didn't even dare to take off the clothes covering his head. He turned around and ran behind him, closing the door at the same time. He didn't stop until his body hit the chair!
"Huh...huh..." Lu An was really panicked, his eyes widened, but he always felt it smelled good. He suddenly realized something and quickly took off the clothes on his head, only to find that they were girls' underwear, so he couldn't help but put them aside!
I saw him sitting in a chair in a panic, his face red as if he had been burned by something, and even seemed to be steaming. He sat with his head bowed and his hands constantly intertwined.
Lu An was restless in the living room, listening to the rustling sounds coming from the bathroom. Knowing that the other party was probably coming out, he couldn't help but swallow a mouthful of saliva, imagining how he would apologize.
Bang!
Lu An was shocked when the door was opened. He quickly looked back and found the girl standing at the door of the bathroom, looking at him angrily.
"Gudong." Lu An swallowed again, stood up quickly, bowed ninety degrees quickly, and said apologetically, "I'm sorry, I really didn't mean it! I'm sorry, I'm sorry!"
I saw Fu Yu standing at the door, his face turning red and white. He didn't even listen to Lu An's apology. He was gnashing his teeth and his whole body was shaking with hatred!
Just now, she had just finished washing her body in the bathtub, and when she came out and was about to wipe her body, this person saw her naked! Not to mention her, who wouldn't be angry if something like this happened to her?
Not to mention this person's apology, even if he kneels down to her, she won't let him go!
Lu An straightened up after bowing, looking a little scared at the angry girl in front of him, standing there at a loss, and said anxiously, "I know, everything is my fault. If you want to scold me or hit me, I am willing to bear it, as long as you can calm down!"
"Calm down?" Fu Yu spoke almost through his teeth, "Do you think I can calm down by beating you?"
"No, no..." Lu An quickly waved his hands and shook his head, and said anxiously, "You can do whatever you want to calm down, I will never resist!"
"I never want to see you again!" Fu Yu gritted her teeth and said, followed by an imperceptible weak golden light slowly touching her pink fist, her eyes full of hatred!
However, Lu An was stunned when he heard this sentence, and his face turned ugly. But he quickly said, "Okay, since you don't want to see me, I'll find a male teacher to change dormitories."
After saying this, Lu An turned around and trotted outside. Fu Yu was startled by this run.
"What should I change?" Fu Yu said gloomily, "The teacher made it very clear that he won't change it! Are you perfunctory with me?"
"Of course not..." Lu An stopped when he heard this, turned back to look at the girl, with an ugly smile on his face, and said, "If it really doesn't work, I will drop out of school and won't bother you again."
After saying that, he turned around and ran towards the door, disappearing into the night.
This time, it was Fu Yu who stood in the dormitory, staring blankly at the figure running further and further away. She didn't know why, but that wide hemp coat that didn't fit her at all made her heart move.
Although she is not a child from a poor family, she also knows what it means to a poor family to enter the academy and become a heavenly master. This person looks even more miserable than the average child from a poor family.Don’t you understand?
Or is this a show deliberately put on for yourself?
"It doesn't matter if he dropped out of school, you have to pay the price for doing something wrong. It's a good thing he ran fast, otherwise I would definitely kill someone!" Fu Yu thought angrily in his heart.
In the night, Lu An was running quickly in the college. There were few pedestrians on the road in the college at this time, and no one would care about him.
